0.original: Baidur is not very good at his job.

48.original: Oh, I am beginning to wonder if I will ever be able to sell my wares. I was so certain I could finally make a success of myself here as a trader...

49.original: Ah, hello there. Tell me, have you ever tried your hand at running your own market stall?

50.original: I myself have been struggling to sell much of anything of late. Observing someone else may be just what I need.

51.original: Let me know if you feel up to the challenge.

52.original: Are you willing to tend to my stall?

53.original: Tending to the merchant's stall will take several minutes. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.

57.original: That is a shame indeed. Please do speak with me again if you change your mind.

58.original: Fantastic! I have a feeling I am going to learn a lot from observing you.

59.original: I have always prided myself on having a varied assortment of goods for sale. There should be something here for every kind of customer. The best of luck to you!

60.original: Listen carefully to each customer and choose something you think will meet their needs.

61.original: Oh my, quite a selection of food you have. Let me think, yesterday we had fish... Trader, what would you recommend for a bunch of growing boys with healthy appetites?

67.original: Hmm, I am not so sure my boys would like that. I think I shall go and buy meat from another stall.

68.original: That does sound nice, doesn't it. I will take your finest mammoth thigh!

69.original: You have failed to make a sale. It appears the customer did not appreciate your recommendation.

70.original: You made a sale! Nicely done.

71.original: Give me a toy! Mummy said I could buy a toy because I've been good. I don't have much money so it should be something cheap. What can I buy?

77.original: That sounds like lots of fun! Give it to me!

78.original: It costs <hex:021A020203>how<hex:021A020103> much!? Mummy didn't give me <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> much money.

79.original: A flute? I've never played one before but maybe Daddy can teach me. I'll take it!

80.original: Oh, I pine for that buxom maiden so, but I know not how to express my feelings. Whatever should I do?

82.original: I've got just the book for you.

83.original: Scream of your love to all of Reunion.

84.original: Good things come to handsome gents.

85.original: You'll get nowhere with a face like that.

86.original: Sorry, did I look like I was soliciting advice? I was just heading home. I'll have you know I've a long night of crying myself to sleep ahead of me!

87.original: You have failed to make a sale. It appears the customer did not appreciate your recommendation.

88.original: A book, you say? Pray tell me, just what is it called?

90.original: <hex:021A020203>A Beginner's Guide to Tumet Child Rearing<hex:021A020103>.

94.original: Are you mocking my love? There are other things I could be doing right now instead of taking your insults. I'll have you know I've a long night of crying myself to sleep ahead of me!

95.original: Love songs? Now that you mention it, I remember her saying she enjoyed music. I will take that book, thank you!

96.original: Do you think this necklace suits me? I just bought it from that stall over there.

98.original: Is that one of the eyes of Nidhogg!?

100.original: What a nice shade of scarlet.

101.original: We have even better jewelry here!

102.original: Tell me then, just what would you suggest I buy?

103.original: I am glad you think so! I fell in love with the color the moment I saw it and knew it had to be mine.

104.original: In fact, I had actually planned on buying two pieces of jewelry today. Do you have anything for sale?

110.original: Ah, those would go perfectly with my necklace! I will have them, thank you.

111.original: That said, I am quite taken with this ruby ring as well... Give me both the earrings and this ring!

112.original: Hmm, I am not so sure the color would suit me. It is awfully drab. No, I think that is enough shopping for today.

113.original: That looks very nice indeed. I shall take it!

114.original: That said, those scarlet earrings would go perfectly with my necklace... Give me both the ring and the earrings!

115.original: I must say I am very impressed. I had no idea there was still so much I had to learn about trading.

116.original: Up until now I had simply recommended whatever I thought was best. But it is clear that the customer's wishes should always be my top priority.

117.original: Thank you for all your help.

118.original: Perhaps you ought to rest for a while. It seems like this may all be a bit too much for you right now. Speak with me whenever you feel ready to try again.
